title: HomePageSkeleton blocks are opt-in and must mirror the real page's conditional sections
answers: Why does the homepage layout shift when the skeleton disappears?
How to add/remove a loading skeleton block that matches a conditionally rendered section
Skeleton reserves space for a section that never renders
body:
Fix pattern: HomePageSkeleton (public/app/features/home/HomePageSkeleton.tsx) takes boolean show* props (showAlertsCard, showIRMNewsCard, showExtra, showSolutions) and only renders a HomeSection block when the corresponding prop is true, so the skeleton never reserves space for a section the real HomePage won't render.
Constraint/invariant: whenever HomePage.tsx adds or conditionally hides a top-level section, the matching show* flag must be threaded into HomePageSkeleton with the same condition, otherwise the page shifts on reveal (skeleton block collapses/appears after content loads). Each opt-in block should carry its own data-testid (e.g. home-page-skeleton-solutions) for test assertions.
